schedule_id.meaning: Schedule id; HTTP reads schedule_id and the CLI uses its positional id.

changed.meaning: Whether the row was changed, including removal of paused.

readback.meaning: Status view after the operation, including schedule, next_fire, last_fire and baseline.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: <raw SQLite or filesystem error text>, <stored JSON parser error text>, and pid2-invalid-json: <parser message> on HTTP. Also protocol-kernel-field-missing:<field>, protocol-kernel-definition-missing:<index> and pid2-command-wake-persist-failed: <error>.
